text_block_list.text:
Some time had passed since the Arima 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm gonna go take a break!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, Sion-san...! Sorry to spring this on 
you out of nowhere! I'm scheduled to debut 
soon! And I want to make my dream come 
true! Could you maybe give me a few words 
of encouragement?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah... Is that so? Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
In the Twinkle Series... I'm sure there'll 
be sad times, happy times, and moments 
where we feel like giving up.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, for me, it was like a total 
struggle through hell. I couldn't run the 
way I wanted to at all. But—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. I've got you, Trainer, and I've 
got an important dream too.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Trust in yourself and Trainer, and keep 
moving forward. I'm sure everything's 
gonna be just fine!"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: H-Ha... Yes! Thank you very much!

Ever since the Arima Kinen ended, Win 
Variation seemed, somehow...
choice_data_list:
As expected, you've really grown 
confident.

As expected, you've really grown 
confident.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ahaha. It's a little embarrassing 
when you put it like that.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
But... yeah. I feel like I can hold my 
head a little higher than before.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I had finally become the 
protagonist of the stage.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...About that, though. While I feel like 
I've become the star, I just can't bring 
myself to believe that I've actually 
surpassed her, you know...?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I guess to me, Orfevre is just way too 
perfect."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Admiration... or rather, my absolute 
ideal, you could say... Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even so, that is precisely why a new dream 
was born.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
To become a leading star who can outshine 
even that. From now on, I want to use that 
as my beacon to move forward, 'kay?

Win Variation laughs brightly. —Come to 
think of it, wasn't Orfevre's departure 
coming up soon?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Whew, another exhausting day. Still... 
there isn't much time before the next 
race, so I gotta keep doing everything I 
can—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Waaah!?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm so sorry! I never dreamed Orfe-san 
would be in a place like this...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. We are both Ritto dorm 
residents, are we not?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I mean, that's true, but...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um—! If you'd like, wanna chat for a 
bit? Maybe go sit over there..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Um... I was kinda regretting it, 
actually."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If only we'd been able to talk more... 
Maybe we could've become closer friends, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, you are asking me to spend my 
precious leisure time conversing with you?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh... Fool, I was only joking.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I had also intended to express my 
gratitude to you and your Trainer 
shortly."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Thanking... us?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...For the next Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, I shall bring those worthy of my 
trust along with me."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I gained that insight from watching you 
and your Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the Arima Kinen, I have been 
pondering what I lack—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
And then, a thought suddenly crossed my 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: That very sight of you all.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Therefore... for the upcoming Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe, I shall march forward 
with someone trustworthy to be the crutch 
for these legs.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph— Silent, are you? How rude.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry. It just took me by 
surprise... ...I honestly never would have 
thought you had such a thing in mind...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Somehow...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Orfe-san is just a competitor like the 
rest of us, after all.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Worrying, reflecting on things... I 
realized that's just how they've been 
handling it.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I feel like for once, I was seen as an 
equal Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Buuut—do your best in the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, okay? ...Just saying.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. An outrageous scoundrel to the very 
end.

A few months later, Orfevre set off for 
overseas. And as for Win Variation—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Phew... ngh! I gotta focus, focus...!

She ran in a GⅡ race held at Nakayama 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ahaha, truth is, a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I thought, 'Fresh start from here!' and 
then felt like I really couldn't afford to 
mess up.

Seeing her stiff smile made me want to 
encourage her. Thinking that, the words 
came out naturally.
choice_data_list: I understand. But it's going to be okay.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. We've worked hard for 
this day, haven't we?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, hold your head high and run your 
heart out.

Yeah, hold your head high and run your 
race.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Hmm... Those words, I've heard them 
somewhere—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing! Hehe... I feel much 
better now. Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"To shine brighter than anyone else, to 
become the greatest protagonist in 
history!"

――Before long, the race got underway. As 
the pace slowed, Win Variation patiently 
bided her time.

And so, as she rounds the third corner, 
her body sinks down sharply for a moment. 
And then—!

"She tore through like a flash of light! 
That dynamic, ferocious sweeping surge 
was—truly..."
It was that scorching, brilliant radiance.
